description: NASA POWER hourly point data. Satellite-based radiation plus assimilated meteorology. A second radiation source, not a forecast.

units.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: Wh/m^2 over the hour (numerically equal to average W/m^2)
units.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DNI: Wh/m^2 over the hour (numerically equal to average W/m^2)
units.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DIFF: Wh/m^2 over the hour (numerically equal to average W/m^2)

time_note: NASA POWER timestamps are the start of the UTC hour, converted to Asia/Colombo, so they fall on the half hour (00:30, 01:30, and so on). The download asks for one extra UTC day at the start and then keeps only the Asia/Colombo dates requested, so the file starts at 00:30 on --start and ends at 23:30 on --end. Open-Meteo hours are labelled on the Colombo clock. Do not join the two on timestamp without resampling. Irradiance is Wh/m^2 for the hour, which is the same number as average W/m^2, and is stored as-is.
attribution: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program.
